title: 第6章 告诉家里人她得到了仙缘
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
一个琉璃瓶装着的水，一大袋红彤彤的汤菜，几个白花花的馒头，两包黄色长条不知名食物和一个圆滚滚的饼子。

    “大嫂，这些都是仙子送的？”

    明远临掐了大腿一把，不敢相信眼前这一切。

    太玄乎了，实在是太玄乎了。

    这么多食物，那是什么人间仙境，他也想去看看。

    荣华珍惜地捧起矿泉水和可乐，将它们小心塞进明远征怀里，“远征，你待会儿走慢点，这杯可乐容易洒。”

    “好。”

    略带冰凉的温度一入手，明远征手都不知道该往哪里放。

    琉璃里面一看装着的就是水，造型如此奇特，要是行军打仗能有这个，何愁担心敌军在水源里面下毒。

    还有这个巴掌差不多大的杯子，里头像是中药，还放着冰块。

    这些...真是神仙吃的食物吗？

    荣华又把容易压坏的汉堡和薯条让明远临藏在身上，嘱咐他千万小心点别压坏了。

    馒头她自己拿着，中午打包的剩菜用野草遮掩后，装进布兜交给明远呈背着。

    最后是花期赠送的药物。

    看见药物的一瞬间，在场的两位武官和一位文官都被震撼到。

    能让身体降温的药贴，用琉璃装着的驱暑气药物，以及治疗伤口脓肿的外用药。

    这些全都是来自于那位神秘的仙子！

    三兄弟完全傻眼了，他们只以为有食物，完全没想到会有如此珍贵的药物。

    明远征立马握住荣华，心疼地摸着手指上面的红痕，“阿华，辛苦你了。”

    荣华莞尔一笑，“夫君，我不累，仙子对我很好。”

    那点活，对几千里的流放路来说完全不算是。

    荣华怕三兄弟身上的伤势加重，立即将碘伏和红霉素拆开，教会了明远征怎么使用，她便让三人先把药上了。

    三兄弟走到一旁，脱掉衣服互相帮着上药。

    明家被判流放，几人身上多多少少都受了伤。

    明远征伤势严重，背上更是挂了几条鞭伤。

    他们一边忍着痛，一边将红霉素仔细地抹在伤口上。

    等到药物干了，才穿上衣服回去。

    荣华利用野草搓了几条野藤，看三人回来，让他们将剩下的药藏在身上。
content_en:
A glass bottle of water, a large bag of red soup, a few white steamed buns, two packages of long yellow unknown food and a round pancake.

    "Sister-in-law, are these gifts from fairies?"

    Ming Yuanlin pinched his thigh, unable to believe what was happening in front of him.

    It's too mysterious, it's really too mysterious.

    With so much food, what kind of paradise on earth was that? He also wanted to see it.

    Ronghua cherished the mineral water and Coke, and carefully stuffed them into Ming Yuanzheng's arms, "Yuanzheng, walk slower later, this cup of Coke is easy to spill."

    "Okay."

    As soon as the slightly cold temperature came into my hands, I didn't know where to put it.

    It seems that the glass inside is filled with water, and the shape is so strange. If you can have this when marching and fighting, there is no need to worry about the enemy poisoning the water source.

    There is also this cup about the size of a palm, which contains traditional Chinese medicine and ice cubes.

    Are these...really the foods that gods eat?

    Ronghua asked Ming Yuanlin to hide the easily crushed burgers and fries on his body, and told him to be careful not to crush them.

    She took the steamed buns herself, and covered the leftovers packed with weeds with weeds before putting them in a cloth bag and giving them to Mingyuan Cheng to carry on his back.

    Finally, there are the medicines given during the flowering period.

    The moment they saw the medicine, the two military attachés and a civilian official present were shocked.

    Medicinal patches that can cool down the body, medicines filled with glass to repel heat, and external medicines for treating wound abscesses.

    These all come from that mysterious fairy!

    The three brothers were completely dumbfounded. They only thought there was food, but they did not expect such a precious medicine.

    Ming Yuanzheng immediately held Ronghua's hand and touched the red marks on his fingers distressedly, "Ahua, thank you for your hard work."

    Ronghua smiled and said, "Husband, I'm not tired. The fairy treats me very well."

    That kind of work is nothing compared to the thousands of miles of exile.

    Ronghua was afraid that the three brothers' injuries would worsen, so she immediately took apart iodophor and erythromycin and taught Ming Yuanzheng how to use them. She then asked the three of them to apply the medicine first.

    The three brothers walked aside, took off their clothes and helped each other apply the medicine.

    The Ming family was sentenced to exile, and several people were more or less injured.

    Ming Yuanzheng was seriously injured, with several whip wounds on his back.

    They endured the pain while carefully applying erythromycin on the wound.

    Wait until the medicine wears off before putting on your clothes and going back.

    Ronghua used weeds to rub some wild vines, and when the three of them came back, he asked them to hide the remaining medicine on their bodies.
title_en: Chapter 6 Telling her family that she has received a fairy fate
